docs.description: Loading placeholder that mirrors the shape of incoming content. Types: text (lines), circle (avatars), rectangular (cards, thumbnails, tables). Sizes sm/md/lg match the final content dimensions. Animate with a subtle shimmer or pulse. Show only when content will appear within ~1s; use Spinner or ProgressBar for longer waits. Pair with aria-busy=true on the wrapping region. See also: ProgressBar for determinate loading, Spinner for short waits.

rules.reason: MUI's Skeleton on the web, always its rectangular variant, restyled by the recipe: its text variant scales the box to 60% of its height, which SOLAR's text lines are not. Its pulse is MUI's, as Spinner's rotation is, since Figma draws a still frame and SOLAR has no token for it. Flutter has no skeleton: its widget is bespoke, pulsing the same way.
As the width, the content's height.
A circle is round (radius.pill); a line and a rectangle take the control radius.
A skeleton mirrors the content it stands in for: a line's width is the text's, a circle's the avatar's, a rectangle's the card's, each by size.
As the width, the content's height (12 to 180).
